summary.decision_semantics: Decision applies to resale recommendation. Accept retains saved critic value (or explicitly reviewed fetch_3 value); correct changes it; hold returns the exact backup resale and authorizes no rise. Buyback classification is corrected independently for every row.
summary.valuation_status: All resale recommendations are estimates or retained baselines. No current realized Moradabad mint sale was independently observed. Approximately 10% negotiation adjustment on seller asks is an estimate, not a sold price; historical sold/out-of-stock labels do not prove transaction amounts.
summary.buyback_policy: All 48 buyback_market fields are null: no condition-specific payable quote was evidenced. Numeric buyback_ceiling is a raw exact-variant Cashify Get Upto or Cashkr up-to figure, retained regardless of its ratio to resale. Ceiling is never a resale floor or justification for a rise. Null means absent or variant/family mismatch, not zero.
summary.net_new_policy: Preserve authoritative net_new_inr on every existing record exactly, including missing values; official current/launch MRPs and saved suggestions to replace it are context only. This output contains no net_new writes.
summary.parent_gates: Parent applies +/-20% weekly movement gate and hard resale/new ceilings, resolves sibling order and warranty overrides, and applies/deploys. Do not lift any hold using automatic sibling repricing. Hard-ceiling conflicts require parent handling, not an unsupported resale increase.
major_findings: Five proposed MacBook rises and the weak M3 fall are held; exact refurbished retail observed online is not a local used-sale observation.
Pixel 11 India configurations and Fold8 1TB are real; several placeholder-like prices may be conservatively reduced only as estimates. Fold8 1TB proposed ladder-only fall is held.
Pixel 10 Pro XL 512GB: current Google India selector is unavailable; retain the record and baseline pending positive SKU-history/India evidence. No phantom-removal recommendation.
Independent fetch_3 review completed all eight keys; Fold6 1TB corrected to 70000 estimate, Tab S11 Ultra unchanged 73000 accepted, other six held.

Saved sources often provide aggregate asks without per-listing URLs or transaction records. Reviewed-only findings are explicitly labelled; live official/retail/ceiling checks do not convert them into observed resale.
summary.live_check_scope: Targeted public source checks: Google Pixel 11/Pro/XL/Fold configurations; Google Pixel 10 Pro/XL current selector; Samsung Fold8 and Fold6 pages; Apple Air/Pro pages; Cashify exact Pixel11 Fold/base512, Fold8 1TB and Fold6 1TB ceilings; exact M4 Pro16, M4 Pro14 and Air15 refurb JSON-LD; iPhone17 and Xiaomi17T refurb JSON-LD; Cashkr exact M4 Pro16 via direct fetch and M4 Pro14/M3 Air13/M4 Air13 via web-rendered pages; one ORU Fold6 256 listing; Xiaomi17T and Reno15 Mini India specifications. Web pages may be cached as indicated by provider. OLX direct rechecks timed out; those aggregates are saved-review evidence only.
summary.write_scope: Only pricing_a.json written in the shared workspace. No phone_db.json, index.html, shared scripts, deployment or external messages changed.
summary.source_url_policy: Only URLs explicitly preserved in saved evidence or actually returned/fetched in this audit are used for exact pages. Where the saved report omitted a variant URL, the known provider homepage is listed and the row says so; it is provenance, not a direct quote-page citation. No source URL is inferred from a model name.
